'''Alliance Maintenance Lecture 139: Battle Maintenance Schedule for an X-wing Starfighter''' was a [[Hologram/Legends|holo]]-lecture produced by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in the [[Alliance Strategy and Tactics Lecture series]] to instruct its members in the proper maintenance of a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]].
